description: Full Word-style ribbon header for the document editor. Presents Home, Insert, Math, Layout, References, Review, and View tabs (plus an optional Header & Footer tab), a quick-access save/undo/redo group, and per-tab command groups such as the block-style gallery, font family and size, character formatting, alignment, spacing, and color pickers.
